notes.title: Drumpf 2: Lost, But Not Forgotten! release date!
notes.notes:
Howdy y'all!

Looks like we're locked and loaded for release on July 15th at 9:00 AM PDT. Tell your friends, tell your bishop, tell your priest! Don't tell your parents!

notes.title: Drumpf 2 Updated Release Date
notes.notes: Just kidding about the 4th of July thing, I guess. It looks like the earliest release date that we can release has been pushed back to the 8th of July. When we're ready (and able) to release, we'll release the game!
